official_sources.title: ScheduledTasks module runtime controls
official_sources.finding: The ScheduledTasks module exposes Start-ScheduledTask for starting existing tasks and Get-ScheduledTaskInfo for reading runtime information.

official_sources.title: Start-ScheduledTask existing task activation
official_sources.finding: Start-ScheduledTask starts one or more already-registered scheduled tasks; it does not justify creating a new runner task.

official_sources.title: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo runtime evidence
official_sources.finding: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo returns last-run runtime information for a named scheduled task and can be used as host-side acknowledgement evidence.

official_sources.title: schtasks run immediate existing task execution
official_sources.finding: schtasks /run starts an existing scheduled task immediately using its stored program and account without changing its schedule.

official_sources.title: Get-Process local PID inspection
official_sources.finding: Get-Process retrieves local process objects and PID information, supporting host-side liveness checks without inferring liveness from a request file.

official_sources.title: Test-Path exact file existence
official_sources.finding: Test-Path determines whether path elements exist and supports checking the canonical starter, devam.ps1 and expected output files before acceptance.

official_sources.title: Start-Process process object and redirection
official_sources.finding: Start-Process can start a program, return a process object with PassThru and redirect standard streams for bounded activation diagnostics.

official_sources.title: Git update-ref transactional locking
official_sources.finding: git update-ref transactions lock queued references and abort when a required reference cannot be locked, supporting fail-closed concurrent state updates.

candidates.name: Exact canonical starter request plus fresh V4 heartbeat acknowledgement
Existing scheduled task immediate activation with no registration or parallel runner
Bounded process activation diagnostics and exact output freshness
Negative control: request present but no host acknowledgement
